messages:
carla: Quick Q — in the new /v2/generate we started enforcing X-Project-ID for project-scoped keys. If the header is missing, should the runtime: fallback to X-Org-ID, return 400, or return 401/403? SDKs currently only set X-Org-ID in some clients. Example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate` — no project header.
ben: My take: missing required parameter -> 400. Auth failure (invalid/malformed key) -> 401. Auth ok but not authorized for project -> 403. Fallbacks are risky because they hide misconfigurations.
carla: +1 on the semantics. Was wondering if we need a short grace period where we accept X-Org-ID as fallback to avoid breaking older SDKs.
alice: SDK note: a lot of our clients (node/python) only added X-Project-ID in the last release. If runtime starts returning 400 immediately, a bunch of integrations will break. We should coordinate a bump/compat window.
djensen: From infra/SRE: fallback increases blast radius. If an org contains multiple projects, implicit fallback could cause data-plane cross-proj access. Strongly prefer explicit error and a clear migration path.
rafael: Product: we need to balance developer experience and safety. Proposal: 30-day compatibility mode where we log and emit a deprecation header when X-Project-ID is missing, but still accept X-Org-ID as fallback. After 30d, switch to 400.
ben: Implementation plan: runtime will accept fallback when `X-Project-ID` missing AND `X-Org-ID` present, but only if `X-Compat-Allow: true` header enabled (flag for internal rollout). Emit `Warning: project-header-deprecated` in response. After 30 days, remove fallback.
carla: Sounds good. What's the status code we should return when fallback is used? 200 but add a `Warning` header? Or 2xx with telemetry event and `Warning`.
djensen: Use 2xx for successful requests, but add `Warning` and increment a metric `auth.missing_project_header`. That lets us observe adoption before hard fail.
alice: SDKs will add X-Project-ID by default in next patch. Can we also add `X-Compat-Allow: true` for the interim releases so clients keep working? @ben can you coordinate flag name and server behavior?
ben: Yes. I'll add a feature flag `auth.accept_project_fallback` in runtime config and a runtime response header `X-Auth-Warning: missing-project-header; use-x-project-id`. We'll also log an event to `auth.missing_project_header` with key fingerprint.
carla: For error mapping: missing header after grace -> 400 with body: `{\"error\":\"missing_project_header\",\"message\":\"Please include X-Project-ID. See migration: https://redwood.ai/docs/auth\"}`. Invalid key -> 401, key with insufficient perms -> 403. OK?
rafael: OK. Add on the migration doc a quick snippet for curl + SDK upgrade notes. Also schedule a short banner on the console for org admins 7 days before hard fail.
infra-bot: Ticket created: RWD-2314 "auth: project header fallback and deprecation plan" assigned to @ben, @carla, @alice. https://redwood.ai/issue/RWD-2314 :spiral_note_pad:
carla: I'll open the runtime PR today with the flag and tests. @ben can you add telemetry and the response header; @alice please add SDK kludge for `X-Compat-Allow` in next patch and then remove after 30d.
ben: Will do. I'll also add unit tests that assert metrics increment and header emitted. Planning a canary rollout at 5% traffic for 48h, then 25% for 72h, then full if no regressions.
djensen: Canary plan fine. Add alert if `auth.missing_project_header` drops by > 95% (we expect it to drop as clients upgrade) or if errors spike.
alice: I'll include an E2E test that simulates a client with only X-Org-ID and asserts we get 200+Warning in compat mode and 400 after we flip the flag in test env.
carla: Great. Timeline recap: PRs this week, canary next week, 30-day public deprecation window starts on canary date. @rafael please confirm console banner schedule and migration doc ownership.
rafael: Confirmed. I'll own docs and the admin banner. Will send a short email to customers in 2 days.
carla: Thanks all. Ping me in PRs for reviews. :thumbsup:
